answer.text: Any act, expression, omission, or concealment to induce dealing in securities

explanation.text: The Logic: Regulation 2(1)(c) defines fraud broadly — act, expression, omission, or concealment. The Trap: Narrow definitions miss the omissions prong. Cross-Exam Context: Same in III-A. Distributor's Pro-Tip: Train front-office on PFUTP — omissions in disclosures are as risky as false statements.
